description: This file defines the AudioInputDeviceObserver class which manages detection and monitoring of audio input devices on macOS. It provides methods for retrieving default input device info, checking device availability, and listening for device changes via CoreAudio APIs.

classes.name: AudioInputDeviceObserver
classes.description: A class that observes and manages audio input device changes on macOS, providing methods for device status checks and change listening.

methods.name: defaultInputDeviceUID
methods.description: Returns the UID of the system's default input device if available.

methods.name: aliveInputDeviceUIDs
methods.description: Returns a set of UIDs for all alive input audio devices.

methods.name: hasUsableDefaultInputDevice
methods.description: Checks if the default input device exists, is alive, and has input channels.

methods.name: defaultInputDeviceSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary string of the default input device, including name and UID.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins monitoring for audio device changes, invoking a callback upon changes.
